name: InterContinental Suzhou
positioning: A 27-storey crescent-shaped hotel on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou Industrial Park, with lake and skyline views and an indoor infinity pool
best_for: Travelers who want a lakeside city base with views of Jinji Lake
Business travelers and groups using the meeting and event facilities

facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou.
The hotel is a 27-storey crescent-shaped building.
The guestrooms, restaurants, lounges and indoor infinity pool have panoramic views of willow-fringed Jinji Lake and the new Suzhou skyline.
The indoor pool on the 3rd floor has an infinity edge that appears to dip right into Jinji Lake.
The heated pool is accompanied by a large Jacuzzi, gender-separated steam and sauna rooms, a sun deck and a chill-out lounge.
Sky Lounge 25 is on the balcony of Club InterContinental on the 25th floor, with a panoramic vista of Jinji Lake and a whisky and cocktail list.
XIU is the hotel's signature modern Chinese restaurant; XIU means embroidery in Mandarin, a timeless symbol of the city.
The hotel is within easy walking distance of Jinji Lake and many shopping and recreation areas.
The Eslite Spectrum Suzhou Store, the first Eslite flagship store in Mainland China, is one step away from the hotel.
Humble Administrator's Garden is about 10 kilometers from the hotel.
The Suzhou Museum, one of the hotel's suggested nearby sights, was designed by architect I.M. Pei.
The hotel has extensive meeting, conference and event facilities.

highlights.text: The indoor infinity pool on the 3rd floor has an edge that appears to dip right into Jinji Lake, with a large Jacuzzi, steam and sauna rooms and a sun deck.
